title: Can the cause change?
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Several observations support accelerated expansion, but its underlying physical explanation remains uncertain. Models include a cosmological constant and alternatives that scientists test.

misconception: A learner may choose: Yes: it is known to be ordinary dust
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Do observations already prove exactly what dark energy is?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Do observations already prove exactly what dark energy is? No: its physical nature remains uncertain. Several observations support accelerated expansion, but its underlying physical explanation remains uncertain. Models include a cosmological constant and alternatives that scientists test.
